questions.title: Virtual Network Isolation
questions.scenario: Your organization needs to establish network isolation in Azure for different business units without managing physical data center networks.

questions.title: Subnet Segmentation Strategy
questions.scenario: You must divide a VNet into smaller address spaces while enforcing distinct security policies per tier for a multi-tier application.

questions.title: Inbound Traffic Filtering
questions.scenario: Your company requires a managed firewall to block unauthorized inbound connections to cloud workloads without manual server configuration.

questions.title: Network Security Rules
questions.scenario: You need to specify which ports and protocols are allowed on VM network interfaces and subnets to enforce least-privilege access.

questions.title: Traffic Distribution
questions.scenario: You must spread incoming application requests across multiple backend VMs to prevent any single server from becoming a bottleneck.

questions.title: Global Edge Routing
questions.scenario: Your web application serves users across continents and needs to route traffic to the nearest regional endpoint for lowest latency.

questions.title: Layer 7 App Delivery
questions.scenario: You need to route HTTP requests to different backend pools based on URL paths and provide built-in web application protection.

questions.title: Domain Name Resolution
questions.scenario: Users access your Azure services through domain names but need reliable, scalable name resolution instead of remembering IP addresses.

questions.title: Site-to-Site Connectivity
questions.scenario: You must establish an encrypted network tunnel between your Azure VNet and on-premises data center over the public internet.

questions.title: Private Dedicated Circuit
questions.scenario: Your organization requires a low-latency, high-bandwidth private connection to Azure that bypasses the unpredictable public internet.

questions.title: Internet-Routable Address
questions.scenario: Your application requires an address reachable from the internet so external users and services can connect to it.

questions.title: Internal Network Address
questions.scenario: Backend database servers should only communicate within the VNet using non-routable addresses to prevent accidental internet exposure.

questions.title: Multi-Network Communication
questions.scenario: Two separate Azure VNets in different regions contain workloads that must communicate directly without routing through on-premises networks.

questions.title: Custom Traffic Routing
questions.scenario: You need to override default VNet routing so all internet-bound traffic flows through a central firewall appliance for inspection.

questions.title: Outbound Connectivity Gateway
questions.scenario: Resources with only private IPs need to initiate outbound internet connections using static IP addresses for firewall allowlisting.

questions.title: Secure Remote Management
questions.scenario: Your team needs RDP and SSH access to VMs without exposing management ports to the internet or assigning public IPs.

questions.title: Attack Traffic Mitigation
questions.scenario: Your public-facing services experience volumetric DDoS floods and need automatic detection and mitigation without dropping legitimate traffic.

questions.title: Private Service Access
questions.scenario: Applications must access PaaS services like SQL Database and Storage through private IP addresses instead of the public internet.

questions.title: Optimized Service Routing
questions.scenario: VNet resources need optimized routing to Azure PaaS services with the ability to restrict access to specific service instances.

questions.title: Global DNS-Based Failover
questions.scenario: Your application spans multiple regions and needs to automatically redirect users to the closest healthy endpoint using DNS.

questions.title: Encrypted Web Communication
questions.scenario: Your web application must encrypt all data in transit between browsers and servers to prevent eavesdropping.

questions.title: Transport Layer Security
questions.scenario: You need a cryptographic protocol to authenticate servers and encrypt all network communications between clients and services.

questions.title: Network Interconnection Point
questions.scenario: Your Azure VNet must connect to either on-premises networks or other VNets, requiring a specialized connection gateway.

questions.title: Transmission Delay Measurement
questions.scenario: A data analytics application experiences slow response times and you need to measure network transmission delay from user to backend.

questions.title: Link Capacity Measurement
questions.scenario: You need to understand how much data your network connection can transfer per second to size your application appropriately.

questions.title: Internal Domain Resolution
questions.scenario: Your VNet needs custom domain name resolution for internal services without publishing them to the public internet.

questions.title: Application-Layer Inspection
questions.scenario: You must inspect HTTP and HTTPS request content to detect and block SQL injection, XSS, and other web-based attacks.

questions.title: Web Attack Protection
questions.scenario: Your e-commerce platform needs protection against common web exploits including SQL injection, cookie theft, and cross-site attacks.

questions.title: Centralized Egress Inspection
questions.scenario: Compliance requires all outbound traffic to route through an on-premises security proxy rather than exiting Azure directly.

questions.title: Dynamic BGP Route Exchange
questions.scenario: Your network contains third-party appliances that advertise and receive routes dynamically instead of relying on static manual configuration.

questions.title: Border Gateway Protocol
questions.scenario: Your hybrid network needs automatic route exchange between on-premises networks and Azure as the topology changes.

questions.title: Volumetric Attack Defense
questions.scenario: Your public applications are targets for large-scale distributed attacks and need automatic protection that scales transparently.

questions.title: Traffic Forwarding Override
questions.scenario: You need to intercept specific traffic patterns and redirect them through a network virtual appliance for custom processing.

questions.title: Global Scale-Out Advantage
questions.scenario: Your multi-region application needs advantages that regional load balancers cannot provide, like instant failover and edge caching.

questions.title: Nearest Endpoint Routing
questions.scenario: A service is deployed at multiple locations worldwide and requests must automatically route to the geographically closest instance.

questions.title: Network Operations Visibility
questions.scenario: You need real-time visibility into network resource health, performance metrics, and usage patterns across your infrastructure.

questions.title: Security Group Traffic Logging
questions.scenario: For compliance and security investigation, you need detailed records of which traffic was allowed or denied by your security policies.

questions.title: Network Troubleshooting Tools
questions.scenario: Your application cannot reach a required service and you need to diagnose whether the problem is routing, DNS, or security policy.

questions.title: Packet-Level Analysis
questions.scenario: You suspect malformed packets are causing application errors and need to capture and examine network traffic at the byte level.

questions.title: Content Edge Delivery
questions.scenario: Your web application serves large media files to users worldwide and needs to cache content at strategic locations closer to users.

questions.title: Distributed Content Caching
questions.scenario: Users experience high latency retrieving content from your origin server and you need to cache copies at network edge locations.

questions.title: Multi-Environment Connectivity
questions.scenario: Your organization operates both on-premises data centers and Azure cloud resources that must function as a single integrated network.

questions.title: Multi-Region Fault Tolerance
questions.scenario: Your mission-critical application must automatically withstand outages in individual Azure regions by distributing across multiple geographies.

questions.title: Automatic Backup Activation
questions.scenario: When your primary service endpoint fails, traffic must automatically switch to a backup system with minimal user impact.

questions.title: System Duplication Strategy
questions.scenario: You must design your network so that a single component failure never causes a complete service outage.

questions.title: Real Data Transfer Rate
questions.scenario: You need to measure actual network performance between your VMs to verify they can sustain the required application workload.

questions.title: Latency Inconsistency
questions.scenario: Your video conferencing application sounds garbled because network delays fluctuate unpredictably between packets.

questions.title: Traffic Priority Management
questions.scenario: Your network carries both latency-sensitive VoIP traffic and bulk file transfers that must not interfere with each other.

questions.title: Critical Performance Factors
questions.scenario: When designing a network to support a data-intensive analytics application, you need to identify which two metrics most determine architectural success.

questions.title: Secure Scalable Design
questions.scenario: Your team needs to design Azure networking that supports growth, protects against threats, and guarantees high availability simultaneously.
